duplicate.instructions: Is this card substantially the same work as an open card or a same-run sibling — work already underway elsewhere on the board?

criteria.yes: An open card or a same-run sibling already covers this work.
criteria.no: No open card or same-run sibling covers this work.

alreadyDone.instructions: Is the work this card describes already resolved or marked obsolete on the board?

criteria.yes: The described work is already resolved or marked obsolete on the board.
criteria.no: The described work is still outstanding.

actionable.instructions: Is there a concrete change a card could carry here?

criteria.yes: A concrete, describable change would move the work forward.
criteria.no: No concrete change is available; there is nothing actionable to carry.
